Bug_Title: Invalid "Date" values should not be used
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the code by setting the date, year, and month values using the setDate(), setYear(), and setMonth() methods of the Date class. The month value is set to 12, which is an invalid value as the month values start from 0 to 11. Similarly, the day of month starts from 1 to 31. This bug will cause the date to roll over to the next year without any error or exception.
